name: UGC 8638 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 8638, a compact irregular dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc8638-hubble
story: A small, compact irregular galaxy dotted with bright knots of stars, resolved by Hubble into its individual stars. Deep studies have found faint plumes of stars around it, likely debris of a smaller galaxy it absorbed.

claims.text: UGC 8638 is a compact irregular galaxy imaged by Hubble ACS in snapshot program 9771
UGC 8638 contains bright compact stellar associations
Hubble resolves its individual stars (tip of the red giant branch measured)
UGC 8638 is an Im (irregular) dwarf galaxy
Faint stellar plumes around UGC 8638 are consistent with debris from a past merger or accretion of a satellite
U8638 is a designation used for UGC 8638
